hero.subheadline: The Workout Plant is Williamsburg's private 1-on-1 personal training & nutrition coaching studio @ 139 Frost St. Improve strength, body composition, and overall fitness with our proven program.

thePlan.headline: Simple, Evidence-Based Systems That Actually Work
thePlan.intro: Led by Head Coach Izzy Jacobus, whether you train with Izzy or one of our trainers, you follow the same structured, evolving program.
thePlan.philosophy: Our approach is built on proven principles: progressive strength training, evidence-based nutrition, and sustainable habits. No fads. No unnecessary complexity. Just a structured, personalized system designed for lasting results.

pillars.title: Individual 1:1 Strength Training
pillars.description: Each 60-minute private session combines progressive strength training with kickboxing or mat pilates and is tailored to your individualized goals.

pillars.title: Evidence-Based Nutrition Coaching
pillars.description: While we specialize in plant-based nutrition, all dietary approaches are supported with a plan tailored to your body composition goals.

pillars.title: 24/7 App & Direct Messaging Accountability
pillars.description: Coaching doesn't stop when you leave 139 Frost St. Through direct messaging and The Workout Plant App, you get:

trainers.name: Izzy Jacobus
trainers.bio: Creator of THE PLAN. Former nutritional counselor at Brooklyn Nurse Practitioners Clinic and experienced kickboxing & strength coach specializing in advanced 1:1 strength training, athletic goals, and individualized nutrition coaching.
trainers.quote: A little over a decade ago, I was obese, sedentary, and struggling with chronic pain that made even everyday activities difficult. I started rebuilding my health with small steps. Walking led to bodyweight exercises, and eventually yoga, kickboxing, and strength training. What began as an effort to reclaim my own health became a passion for helping others do the same.

trainers.name: Analine Ignacio
trainers.bio: Analine combines 1-on-1 progressive strength training with a passion for functional movement, mobility, and core stability. She brings a thoughtful, encouraging approach to helping clients build strength, improve movement, and develop lasting fitness habits.
trainers.quote: I'd always been active and never worried much about nutrition, but during the pandemic, I gained weight and struggled to lose it. I started making small, sustainable changes—improving my eating habits, gradually increasing my daily steps, and focusing on consistent strength and movement along the way. Losing 40 pounds taught me that consistency matters more than perfection and inspired me to help others make lasting changes.

trainers.name: Dev Buchanan
trainers.role: Junior Personal Trainer & HIT Pilates Instructor
trainers.bio: Dev blends 1-on-1 progressive strength training, athletic conditioning, and core-focused movement to help clients build confidence, improve their fitness, and feel stronger in everyday life.
trainers.quote: I've always been passionate about fitness, cycling through phases of spin, CrossFit, jiu-jitsu, and strength training. But for a long time, partying and unhealthy habits took priority over consistency. In 2023, I made the decision to commit to sobriety for good. Strength training became my anchor, giving me structure, transforming my body composition, and helping me rebuild my confidence. What began as a personal transformation grew into a passion that ultimately inspired me to pursue fitness professionally.

faqs.question: Do I need to be vegan or plant-based to train here?
faqs.answer: No! While we specialize in plant-based nutrition, all dietary approaches are supported and tailored to your goals.

faqs.question: How often do I need to train to see results?
faqs.answer: Our evidence-based foundation: 2–4 strength sessions per week using compound movements (1–2 reps from failure), paired with ~0.7g of protein per pound of goal bodyweight.

faqs.question: What should I wear and bring?
faqs.answer: Wear something comfortable and bring a water bottle. No shoes in the studio! We provide towels and everything else you'll need.

faqs.question: What is your cancellation and rescheduling policy?
faqs.answer: No refunds. Reschedule up to 48 hours before your session. No-shows are charged the full session amount.

faqs.question: What happens if I arrive late?
faqs.answer: Arrivals 15+ minutes late are charged in full. Arrivals 10+ minutes late may result in a shortened session.

faqs.question: Where is the studio located?
faqs.answer: 139 Frost St, Brooklyn, NY 11211 in Williamsburg.

faqs.question: How do I know which trainer to choose?
faqs.answer: Choose Head Coach Izzy ($170, or $150 virtual) for advanced 1:1 strength training and individualized nutrition coaching, Analine ($115) for progressive strength and mobility, or Dev ($95) for strength and conditioning. All sessions are private, one-on-one, and one hour.
